# period type

The kind(s) of a named period. Non-functional: competing classifications coexist.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:NamedPeriod`](../classes/gmeow-NamedPeriod.md) -> [`gmeow:PeriodType`](../classes/gmeow-PeriodType.md)

## Practical Pattern

[`gmeow:NamedPeriod`](../classes/gmeow-NamedPeriod.md), [`gmeow:PeriodType`](../classes/gmeow-PeriodType.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to classify a [`gmeow:NamedPeriod`](../classes/gmeow-NamedPeriod.md) by one or more [`gmeow:PeriodType`](../classes/gmeow-PeriodType.md) values — a period may legitimately be both a geologic epoch and a culturally named era.

### Avoid when

- Avoid forcing a single classification in a merge — competing source classifications coexist (non-functional, P9) — and avoid using it to carry the period's bounds.

### How to use

- Attach one or more seeded [`gmeow:PeriodType`](../classes/gmeow-PeriodType.md) individuals; conflicting classifications from different vantages stay side by side rather than collapsing to one.

### Examples

- ex:holocene [`gmeow:periodType`](gmeow-periodType.md) [`gmeow:periodTypeGeologicEpoch`](../individuals/gmeow-periodTypeGeologicEpoch.md).
